name: Conscript of the Horde
summary: Along Durotar’s western road, Conscript of the Horde sends recruits toward the Barrens. Takrin Pathseeker watches beyond Razor Hill and gives them a letter for Kargal Battlescar, whose outpost guards the crossing.

sections.title: Crossing the Southfury
sections.body: After proving your strength around Razor Hill, you are called west to serve the wider Horde. Takrin Pathseeker watches the road out of Durotar for his friend, veteran Kargal Battlescar. He gives capable travelers a recruitment letter to carry across the Southfury River. For a recruit, the letter marks a first formal assignment beyond the orcs’ new homeland.

sections.title: Border Defense
sections.body: Kargal Battlescar holds the outpost beyond the bridge, between Durotar’s red canyons and the dry Barrens. He gathers recruits to guard the frontier, where centaur, quilboar, and Alliance expeditions test the border. The Horde needs more than guards there: raw manpower is being sent to the settlement of the Crossroads.

faq.q: Where do I take the recruitment letter?
faq.answer: Take the western road out of Razor Hill and cross the wooden bridge over the Southfury River. Kargal Battlescar waits at the Horde watchtower just across the border, on the Barrens side.
Takrin Pathseeker is a Horde scout on the western road outside Razor Hill. He watches the road and sends capable warriors west to his comrade Kargal Battlescar.

Kargal Battlescar is a gruff veteran officer at the eastern Barrens watchpost. He inspects arriving volunteers, signs their conscription papers, and directs them west across the savanna to aid the Crossroads.

faq.q: What happens after Kargal signs the letter?
aliases: what after conscript of the horde
faq.answer: After Kargal accepts the letter, he enlists you for further service and sends you west along the main road to report to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.

faq.q: Why is the Horde recruiting soldiers for the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Barrens is an open frontier that connects Orgrimmar with Mulgore. Fierce quilboar tribes, centaur marauders, and Alliance incursions threaten supply routes, so the Horde needs every able hand to keep the roads secure.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. This service is only for Horde members moving from the early Durotar story into the Barrens.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, this conscription marks your move from protecting Durotar to defending Horde lands across Kalimdor.
As a young orc leaving the Valley of Trials and Razor Hill, answering Kargal Battlescar’s call is a rite of passage in service to the Warchief.
As a Darkspear troll, you join your orc allies in this deployment to aid the Horde’s expansion and secure the lands bordering the Great Sea.
